description: US address parser / normalizer — Parse and normalize a free-form US postal address offline into house number, pre/post directional, street name, USPS suffix (Publication 28 abbreviations: Avenue to AVE, Suite to STE), unit, PO box or rural route, recipient/company, city, state (names or codes, N.Y. style ok), ZIP and ZIP+4. Returns standardized line1/line2/last line, ZIP-to-state consistency check, confidence and issues. Batch up to 100 with addresses=a|b|c. Does not confirm deliverability; pair with /v1/geo/geocode. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

address.description: e.g. 350 Fifth Avenue, Suite 3300, New York, NY 10118

name: util_address_parse
